# Original resources through incoming writes and cached index updates

Exact incoming observations: b61b9fda90c3dafdb2ad977ea55e393536a3058e.
Actual incoming writes: fbb3097d536920d15c74ce80d893bc25b5db3e3e.

## Strongest claim and remaining scope

H6, SourceCurrentColdFiniteWarmCalls.constructed_node_calls, remains the
strongest end-to-end language theorem. A covered closed construction and a
valid initial constraint-allocation history supply complete actual finite
modeled node-processing rounds, with sufficient fuel and one mathematical
word width selected after construction. The inherited payload is empty.
The final available value has exactly the initial finite-tree language for
every ambient context and term under the formal Formula/Entailment interface.
The theorem applies to any prescribed finite NUMBER of those modeled rounds.
It does not cover arbitrary mixed operations or the full recursive driver.

The new resource producers extend actual incoming execution and its cached
index update. They do not change H6. Whole recursive completion, whole-driver
language, terminal fallback, native Graph correspondence, concrete solver and
host-container correspondence, extraction, arbitrary lazy GHC demand and
convergence remain separate obligations. Mathematical bounds are not useful
runtime performance bounds.

## Match the same query and optional-check endpoint

EnabledEmpty.optional_done_unique compares two completed optional checks
from the SAME query, full checked input, fourth memo and query memos.
It derives equality of the answer, entire checked return, saved fourth memo
and output query memos. Different worker and reader fuels are permitted.
The disabled arm is immediate. The enabled arm uses deterministic descendant
memo execution and WorkerActual.call_done_unique at the same actual call.

IncomingQuery.raw_done_resources takes current Context, closed available
operands, initial Fits, Room and a guard alphabet. It also takes the actual
completed native query and optional-check observations. The existing complete
resource producer constructs a completion from those current inputs. Native
completion uniqueness identifies its query and full checked return with the
supplied observation. Optional-check uniqueness identifies the final state.
The original forecast therefore bounds the supplied endpoint exactly.

This observer does not lift arbitrary bare success to a rich checked Trace.
It uses current semantic readiness and explicit initial Room. It does not
add an arbitrary future range or successful operation as a producer input.
The complete earlier incoming-query interface stays unchanged.

## Derive current incoming admission

IncomingNode.initial_ranges uses PendingRealized for the current enumeration
slots. A stored old handle decodes to a closed available value in the SAME
current heap. Current readiness and Fits.room supply the physical bounds.
closed_original and warm_initial_ranges derive the old admission predicate.
Missing, enumerated, eliminated and missing-old-node arms require no query.

IncomingNode.observed_resources bounds every outer .ok observation of the
literal IncomingNode.run worker. Its result may be none, raw [], successful
rows or inner Except errors. Early unsupported paths retain the initial
caller. Forecast monotonicity supplies their conservative resource bound.
A realized pending old node performs the actual native query and optional
check. raw_done_resources supplies bounds at that exact returned caller.
The encoding and enumeration writes retain that caller. Native yielded,
failed, constraint-error and blocked arms remain outer .error. A failed
optional check also remains outer .error. None is converted to success.

The theorem requires no target-root, storage or pending-slot premise beyond
the current realized slots. The completion producer needs those stronger
current facts to construct its actual successful outer observation.

## Retain the entire earlier completion packets

IncomingNode.run_complete_resources derives initial_ranges and invokes the
old run_complete producer ONCE. It retains the same witnesses and all earlier
receipts. Its actual observation at the produced fuel supplies returned Fits
and the predicted guard carrier. The old output proposition has 2935 source
characters after width specialization and equivalent Checked-alias expansion.
Its SHA256 is:
66c36ba56ba3e6e938bcbc5159dfb6bba91e69581a7cad79928648270d083f0d.

CachedIncoming.complete_resources uses the same method for complete.
It retains the same actual getValue frames, raw execution, logical write
prefix, exact core update, storage, PendingRealized, full Post, memo relations,
replacement readback and exact optional/present intersection-language packet.
It also retains stable native-index execution, counter and representative
facts, roots, waiting counts, flags and expandable-index equality. The old
output proposition has 4140 source characters after width specialization.
Its SHA256 is:
3b32e0d3598dbc67e19f032d3ab3e90123bcd7afc5d45bfaacd77afed269d1b6.

The appended Fits and carrier concern the SAME returned native caller.
The full old propositions are source-equal before those appended fields.
The wrappers do not duplicate the old storage, ancestry or index proofs.

## Retain rejection and resource boundaries

The old raw observation returns [] if the replacement is Empty. Native query
and optional-check effects still occur and remain in its returned caller.
The old producer separately retains a logical setValue/inheritAncestry prefix
and its cached index certificate. The literal raw rejection has no successful
row. Do not identify that logical post-write cache with an observable success.
Do not derive Safe at that rejected cache from this theorem.

The initial alphabet and numeric profile determine the combined forecast.
The enabled Call 1000 allocation is included. A missing old node retains the
original caller and fits the same conservative forecast by monotonicity.
The final resource predicate is Fits. It does not reserve next-query Room.
No returned-heap forecast, future callback, range packet or success receipt
is an initial admission premise for either completion producer.

## Next actual integration work

Propagate these bounds through the actual cached terminal fold and adapter.
The existing Fold.Ranges is future-universal. Derive each next entry's Room
from an original forecast instead. Include both native intersection and the
optional enabled emptiness worker's allocation. A query-count-only advance
reservation does not cover this mixed execution. Keep actual native effects.

Then cover selected edges, concrete callbacks, bounded recursive subtrees and
later siblings. Legacy ordinary Ranges uses sibling endpoints before those
continuations. It does not reserve space at their actual recursive returns.
Retain per-output Posts at each emission endpoint and a separate final native
Post. Keep the full old completion propositions throughout this integration.
